def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); out=[r[:] for r in I]
    # find pattern: non-zero cells; pattern cells exclude stray single 5s
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat={(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in cells}
    # anchor: cell whose color count in pattern is 1 (demo case: 5)
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in cells: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    anchor=next(v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1)
    acolor=[v for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]
    acr,crc=[r for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]-r0, [c for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]-c0
    strays=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5]
    for mr,mc in strays:
        tl=(mr-acr, mc-crc)
        for (rr,cc,v) in pat:
            r,cc2=tl[0]+rr,tl[1]+cc
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=cc2<W: out[r][cc2]=v
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import json
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in cells: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    # anchor: unique color
    unic=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
    anchor=unic[0]
    acr,crc=None,None
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if v==anchor:
            acr,crc=r-min(r for rr,cc,_ in cells),c-min(cc for rr,cc,_ in cells)
    r0=min(rr for rr,cc,_ in cells); c0=min(cc for rr,cc,_ in cells)
    pat=[(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in cells if v!=anchor]
    for mr,mc in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5]:
        tl=(mr-acr,mc-crc)
        for rr,cc,v in pat:
            r,cc2=tl[0]+rr,tl[1]+cc
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=cc2<W: out[r][cc2]=v
    return out
print(all(f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']))
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(r)
